scope: User-directed friend/group competition, participating geographic pools, shareable top-three badges, player characters, accessories and confirmed win/loss recaps; includes the previously started Studio value improvements.

implemented.podiums: Category-specific friend-circle and accepted-group standings require three revealed comparable estimates. Top-three enamel badges appear on Home and Profile. Ties share a place; next-estimate gaps and labelled1080x1350 private PNG exports use the actual snapshot.
implemented.geography: Opt-in, declared neighbourhood/district/city/region/country pools are wired. Geographic podiums preserve the existing validated-model, Established shared-comparison-class and minimum20-player gates. A sampled pool above5000 cannot award a badge. These are participating SHUTTL pools, not complete rankings of every player in a location.
implemented.characters: Original native-vector Feather One starter, three body styles, four accessory choices and three celebrations. The same starter is available to everyone. Wardrobe selection persists; selected players show characters in recording, own identity and Home. Character appearance is a public cosmetic, not private journal data.
implemented.unlocks: Server-derived counts of unique published physical match units, wins and an earned three-win run determine availability. A later ordinary loss does not erase a previously earned run; approved corrections can revise supporting history and equipped items fall back safely. Pending, duplicate or forged client counts cannot unlock an item. No rating bonuses or daily attendance penalty.
implemented.recaps: Confirmed wins use green and winning choreography; losses use a warm red surface, a bowed own character and celebrating opponents with their equipped looks. Own published estimate/change is shown in the same recap; pre-five numbers and first-reveal deltas remain hidden. Motion is finite and respects reduced-motion settings. Unconfirmed submissions cannot present published rating impacts.
implemented.studio: Private preparation/reflection playbook, session journal, conflict recovery, downloads, real close-game/third-game score patterns and an own score-history CSV. Account export includes private data; account deletion removes it.

criticalAppraisal.method: Root AI judgment after reviewing real fictional-player mobile renders and actual journeys. Test counts do not determine grades. No measured willingness to pay, retention or human testimony is claimed.
whyNotNine: The Studio now helps a regular player prepare, review and retain their playing history, but statistical analysis and self-authored notes are not equivalent to personalized coaching.
Friend density is central to social value. Cosmetic art and medals cannot create an active real-world playing circle by themselves.
Occasional-player willingness to purchase remains a materially weaker case. Core ratings, recording and competitive identity should remain broadly accessible.
Geographic podiums are intentionally forming in the current uncalibrated pilot; live geographic dominance is not an available demonstrated benefit yet.
criticalAppraisal.visualLimits: The character is an original polished2D starting collection. It is not a claim of a final premium3D character system, a vast accessory library or universally9.5-rated artistic quality.
remainingProductWork: Further character art direction and a larger coherent unlock collection
Qualification and population evidence for live geographic podiums
Source-derived geographic podium-change alerts beyond existing friend-passing updates
Retention and monetization assessment of the core social loop
Scale testing beyond bounded local pools

firstCompleteBrowserRun.failure: A new test incorrectly assumed the latest competitive-persona result was a win. Earlier actual play had recorded a loss and the app correctly displayed the loss recap.

verification.exactHeadCompleteGithubRun: Pending at documentation time; expected116 browser cases.
verification.accessibility: Automated checks cover four Studio views in both themes plus narrow enlarged-text Playbook, saved wardrobe in both themes, both result states and podium cards. No detected violations in these recorded states. This is not full assistive-technology certification.
verification.limitations: Fictional users and Chromium viewport emulation; no HTTPS deployment, payment integration or empirical launch-readiness claim.
